reels.summary:
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer says the latest restrictions on advanced chips are aimed at closing loopholes in existing export controls, not imposing a new ban on China.

Greer says Chinese companies remain eager to access advanced US chips, even as parts of the Chinese government push to grow the market for domestic alternatives like Huawei.
